subject: physics_2
question_text: What is zener voltage and how will a zener diode be connected in circuits generally.

verification.note: The 1+1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. recall_prompt: Define the zener voltage, then say which way round a zener diode is connected.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Zener voltage
lines: Zener voltage: the reverse voltage at
which the current through a zener diode
increases suddenly. It is also called the
steps.margin_note: First mark. The word 'reverse' must appear — a forward voltage of this name does not exist.
steps.why: The zener voltage is a point on the reverse part of the characteristic curve. Up to it the reverse current is tiny and almost fixed; at it the current rises steeply while the voltage hardly changes, and that steep piece is what every zener circuit uses.
common_mistakes: Defining it as the forward voltage at which the diode starts to conduct. That is the knee voltage, about 0.7 V for silicon.
Saying the voltage increases suddenly. It is the CURRENT that increases suddenly.

recall.must_convey: That the zener voltage is the reverse voltage at which the current increases suddenly.
accept: reverse voltage at which current rises sharply
voltage where the diode breaks down

steps.memory_tip: Zener voltage is a reverse voltage where the CURRENT jumps, not the voltage.

steps.label: How it is connected
lines: In circuits a zener diode is generally
connected in reverse bias, so that it

lines.text: Zener diode: always in reverse bias

steps.margin_note: Second mark. Reverse bias, and say why: to keep it in breakdown.
steps.why: A zener diode connected forward is just an ordinary diode, so the whole reason for choosing a zener disappears. It is put in reverse so the circuit sits on the flat breakdown part of the curve where the voltage is fixed.
common_mistakes: Saying it is connected in forward bias like other diodes.
Connecting it in reverse with no series resistor. Without one the breakdown current is not limited and the diode is damaged.

recall.must_convey: That a zener diode is connected in reverse bias.
accept: so that it works in breakdown

steps.memory_tip: Both halves of this answer are the same word: reverse.

insider_note: Both parts turn on the word reverse — the reverse voltage in the definition and the reverse connection in the circuit.
